We switched the subscription part last Monday, Thomas finished StoreKit integration and it runs in sandbox. Two things remain: the transcription history which hasn't started and the personalized vocabulary which has a spec but no code. We have 412 downloads since launch with a 19% 7-day retention rate which is low but not terrible for a first version. The goal is to pass the 1000 mark before the end of October. I meet Sarah on Thursday at 2pm to line up the Apple Store part. If everything goes well we will submit the week of the 12.
